title: Immich External Library Scan Duration
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=immich:job job_type=library_scan
| stats avg(duration_min) as avg_duration_min, max(duration_min) as max_duration_min by library
| where avg_duration_min>30 OR max_duration_min>60
| sort - avg_duration_min
description: Uses Immich library scans telemetry to monitor how long external-library scans are taking in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for libraries that have become slow to index, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Immich library scans data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Library table of average and maximum scan duration.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how long external-library scans are taking so you can spot libraries that have become slow to index before it becomes annoying.
